limits: Records data JSON fields are governed by positive subject export schemas; this is not a full institution field inventory.
No external IdP/LMS/OBS/PSP/KMS/backup inventory or legal retention period is inferred.
Structural hashes and pseudonyms can remain personal data; raw security records are not self-service exports.
Free-text authored by the subject may mention others; no semantic anonymization claim.

Authority files are untrusted local attachments, admin-only downloads; no automatic malware, signature or institutional authenticity validation. Raw bytes stay out of workspace and command results, but the immutable local file record needs an approved retention policy.
Material deliveries export only receipt metadata for the owner; source files and rights-review actor details are not copied into self-service summaries.

Recognition compact-JWT deliveries retain actual untrusted bytes only in private local file records. Workspace, subject export and idempotency results contain no raw file. Exact-byte downloads require current person/unit/role/MFA and audit; production storage, scanner, retention, signature and issuer/subject validation remain separate.

External issuer public descriptor excludes the private subject mapping. Signature receipts contain no JWT or raw claims; positive self-service export excludes issuer/subject/key digests and reviewer details. Cryptographic verification is separate from status checking and academic credit.
